dedupe_keys.name: benchmark data set for wheat growth models field experiments and agmip multi model simulations

description: A benchmark for testing wheat crop models against field data. The CCAFS publication page (2015) says the dataset holds representative treatments from quality-tested field experiments with wheat at four contrasting sites in Australia, the Netherlands, India and Argentina, with daily weather, soil characteristics, frequent growth measurements, nitrogen and water in crop and soil and yield components, plus results from 27 wheat models and sensitivity analyses with 26 models over 30 years (1981 to 2010) for higher CO2 and temperature, heat stress at anthesis, management variations and an end-century climate scenario. The article is free to read and download. Coverage is four sites. Caveats: the page read does not give the data licence or repository link. For simulation it lets modellers calibrate and test crop models used in climate impact chains for food supply. A related catalogue record is the GGCMI global gridded crop model outputs.
